evidence_spans: For hBN-encapsulated WSe 2, time-resolved PL revealed a decay time of only∼2ps for the bright exciton, compared with∼110ps for the grey exciton at 12 K [28].

For hBN-encapsulated WSe 2, time-resolved PL revealed a decay time of only∼2ps for the bright exciton, compared with∼110ps for the grey exciton at 12 K [28].
CLM-MAT-0170.statement: In monolayer WSe2, the decay time of the bright exciton measured by time-resolved PL at 12 K is 2 ps.
